findings.quote: diacetoxypalladium (20.76 mg, 0.09 mmol) was added to 5-bromopyridin-3-amine (160 mg, 0.92 mmol), morpholine (4028 µl, 46.24 mmol) (9,9-dimethyl-9H-xanthene-4,5-diyl)bis(diphenylphosphine) (64.2 mg, 0.11 mmol) and cesium carbonate (603 mg, 1.85 mmol).
findings.message: The source adds diacetoxypalladium to the other reagents, whereas the plan places it first. Move its addition after the receiving reagents; their internal charging order is unspecified.

findings.quote: The resulting suspension was stirred at 150 °C for 30 minutes in a microwave.
findings.message: Temperature, duration and stirring are captured, but microwave heating is not preserved as an operational condition. Record it in unmapped_actions because the allowed HeatChill fields cannot express it.
